risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows a confirmed account takeover chain for prof.kaya@aegean.edu: password spray (T1110.003) from 193.140.10.21 against 54 accounts/60 failures followed by a successful sign-in as this user (T1078) (F4, 0.85). This is corroborated by impossible travel Manisa→Lisbon in 32 min (F1, 0.7) and a suspicious sign-in from Turkcell (TR) outside the account baseline (F2, 0.75). The VPN appliance CISA KEV findings (F5/F6) are contextual edge exposure but do not override the account-level confirmation. Signals are not explained away (not benign), are stronger than weak/unexplained (not monitor), and evidence is sufficient and consistent rather than conflicting/insufficient (not escalate).
